channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Rock Block H
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Rock Block H (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block H: The Port's June 2026 report on Phase 2 does not name Block H
item.description: The Port's June 2026 report on Phase 2 does not name Block H; the Port Commission approved up to $10 million of Phase 2 pre-development funding on June 9, 2026, and no source read reports construction on this block. The Board of Supervisors' own records date the Mission Rock DDA approval (Resolution 42-18) to February 13, 2018 and the final passage of the Development Agreement ordinance (No. 33-18) to February 27, 2018; the Notice of Determination gives March 6, 2018 as the City's approval date and lists the Board's EIR action (File 171286) among its final actions. The Port's fact sheet lists August 15, 2018 as the Development Agreement's effective date, and the Planning page dates the DDA 8/15/2018. The Port's January 2018 staff report describes the DDA's outside dates for starting later phases (a legal deadline, not a forecast); the DDA text itself has not been read, so no calendar date is given. The Port's June 2026 report schedules the Developer's Phase 2 Submittal for Winter/Spring 2027 and a possible construction start for Summer/Fall 2027 (expected dates); no source read reports construction or a vertical design submittal for this block or states its current use. DDA-specific section numbers and target dates previously listed here are removed because the DDA text has not been read. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf https://www.sfport.com/media/11337/download?inline https://sfbos.org/sites/default/files/r0042-18.pdf https://sfbos.org/sites/default/files/o0033-18.pdf https://sfplanning.s3.amazonaws.com/sfmea/2013.0208ENV-Seawall%20Lot%20337_NOD.pdf https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Commission/Item%2011A%20Mission%20Rock%20Approvals%20Staff%20Report%201-26-18FINAL.pdf https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2021-07/Mission%20Rock%20Fact%20Sheet_24June2021.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block H: Block H's note no longer says the Port describes it as a…
item.description: Block H's note no longer says the Port describes it as a surface parking lot; the Port's June 2026 memo uses that phrase as a goal for the whole project. It says only that Phase 2 is positioned to begin construction as early as 2027, an expected start. The method log now also says that only two of the four Phase 1 block-to-lot pairings are tied to a source, that four lots used for snapping carry a 2025 drop date in DataSF, and that the traced area is about 31,021 square feet. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block H: Block H's record and map shape now say: the base building…
item.description: Block H's record and map shape now say: the base building maximum is 60 ft on the Mission Rock Street side and 40 ft on the Terry A. Francois Boulevard side (not 40 ft only); 'across from Mission Bay South' was removed because the Design Controls do not say it; the flex designation is cited to the Design Controls, not the 2012 proposal; 'unbuilt' is dated to the Port's June 2026 update; the EIR's illustrative phasing is no longer said to be 'superseded by the DDA phasing'; the earlier statement that the lots match the plan within 3% is corrected by a new dated note; the Port Commission actions of 2018, 2023 and 2025 cite the minutes and misquoted wording was corrected; and source citations were fixed. The shape is unchanged. Source: Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Design Controls, 2018-04-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Phase 2 update (Port Commission Item 11A), 2026-06-09 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf); SF Planning, Seawall Lot 337 and Pier 48 Mixed-Use Project Draft EIR, Chapter 2, 2017-04 (https://sfplanning.s3.amazonaws.com/sfmea/MissionRock_Ch_2_ProjectDescription.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2018-01-30 (https://www.sfport.com/media/3353/download), 2023-10-10 (https://www.sfport.com/media/9218/download?inline), 2025-03-11 (https://www.sfport.com/media/10376/download?inline).

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block H: The Jan 30, 2018 approval milestone cited 'Resolutions 18-03…
item.description: The Jan 30, 2018 approval milestone cited 'Resolutions 18-03, 18-04'. Port sources number the Design Controls resolution differently (the Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested it as 18-04; the Sep 2019 Port memo numbers it 18.05), and the Jan 30, 2018 minutes record Resolutions 18-03 to 18-10 as adopted, so the milestone now cites that range. Source: Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, Jan 30 2018 (https://www.sfport.com/media/3353/download); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 11A staff report, 2018-01-26 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Commission/Item%2011A%20Mission%20Rock%20Approvals%20Staff%20Report%201-26-18FINAL.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 7A staff report, 2019-09-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%207A%20Mission%20Rock%20Phase%201%20Budget%20Approval%20%28003%29.pdf).

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block H: Port staff say later phases 'may require higher… (Mar 11, 2025)
item.description: Port staff say later phases 'may require higher percentages of BMR units' to reach the project's 40% target after Phase 1 was cut to 132 BMR units; the Port, developer and MOHCD are reviewing changes 'with the goal of improving the feasibility of future Phases of Mission Rock and accelerating development' (Resolution 25-17) (Mar 11, 2025). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-03-07; Port of San Francisco, 2025-03-11.

item.title: Planned · Mission Rock Block H: Port Commission adopts Resolution 23-46 (passed… (Oct 10, 2023)
item.description: Port Commission adopts Resolution 23-46 (passed unanimously as amended, with non-substantive changes); its recitals state that Phase 2 is 'not currently financially feasible' and that Port and Developer staff 'mutually agreed earlier this year to decelerate work on Phase 2 while waiting for macroeconomic conditions to improve' (Oct 10, 2023). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-10.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-10

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block H: Developer sends the Port its Phase 2 Submittal… (Dec 28, 2022)
item.description: Developer sends the Port its Phase 2 Submittal (with a Garage Report submitted October 14, 2022 and a Basis of Design November 18, 2022); the budget and appraisal elements are deferred (Dec 28, 2022). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06.

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block H: Development Agreement takes effect (the Port's… (Aug 15, 2018)
item.description: Development Agreement takes effect (the Port's fact sheet lists the DA effective date as Aug. 15, 2018, with a 30-year term and 4 phases); the Planning page dates both the Development Agreement and the DDA 8/15/2018 (Aug 15, 2018). Source: SF Planning; Port of San Francisco, 2021-06-24.

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block H: The Notice of Determination gives March 6, 2018 as… (Mar 6, 2018)
item.description: The Notice of Determination gives March 6, 2018 as the date the City 'decided to carry out or approve the project' and lists the Board of Supervisors' final actions, including File No. 171286 (affirming the Planning Department's certification of the Final EIR) and File No. 180092 (the DDA); it was filed March 9, 2018. The Board's own records date two of the other approvals earlier: Resolution 42-18 (the DDA, File 180092) was adopted February 13, 2018, and Ordinance 33-18 (the Development Agreement, File 171313) was finally passed February 27, 2018. The Port's Oct 2023 report calls No. 33-18 a Resolution and its June 2026 report an Ordinance; the Board's file shows an ordinance (Mar 6, 2018). Source: SF Planning, 2018-03-09; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-05; San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2018-02-13; San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2018-02-27.
item.source: SF Planning, 2018-03-09; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-05; San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2018-02-13; San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2018-02-27
